items.name: Arcane Deciphering
items.desc: Various artifacts and technologies functioning by arcane means that cannot be understood or replicated... at least not by conventional science as it is known to us.

items.name: Curator Archaeology Lab
items.desc: A shipboard lab with advanced archaeological equipment, including a vast database supplied by the Curator Order where new discoveries can easily be cross-referenced.

items.name: Archaeostudies
items.desc: This new field of studies focuses on the practical applications of ancient artifacts. We are far from being the first galactic civilization to tread these stars. With a bit of work, their legacies could secure our future.

swaps.name: Archaeostudies
swaps.desc: This new field of studies focuses on the practical applications of ancient artifacts. We are far from being the first galactic civilization to tread these stars. With a bit of work, their legacies could secure our future.

items.name: Cybrex Mining Hub
items.desc: To build their ring world, the Cybrex relied on highly efficient mining drones to survey and harvest orbital resources. Cybrex-made memory chips and sensors could augment our own mining operations, so that we might put their millennia old algorithms to good use.

items.name: First League Filing Offices
items.desc: The sprawling empire of the First League dwarfed our own at its peak, and relied on implacable bureaucracy to keep the wheels of the state in motion. The quantic filing arrays they used afforded them unprecedented efficiency in the sorting and storing of documents.

items.name: Irassian Naval Yards
items.desc: The Irassian astronaval tradition was unmatched in their time. Their shipyards produced a constant stream of ships for their navy and merchant fleets, which would ultimately be their downfall. With so many ships, and such a high reliance on them, the Irassians were powerless to quarantine the disease that would claim their empire.

items.name: Vultaum Reality Computer
items.desc: The reality computers of the Vultaums were unique processing units, dedicated to analyzing existence itself, not quite through physics, but rather by trying to reverse engineer reality's source code and find the glitch that would finally allow the Vultaums to take down the simulation where they believed they lived.

items.name: Yuht Astronomical Interferometer
items.desc: The Yuht were a paradoxical society, obsessed with the idea of finding other sentient species, yet refusing to accept that they were not alone. They were so focused on disproving any claim of alien life, that their bias found a way into their technology. However, with the proper modifications and calibrations, we could certainly fix their powerful detection arrays.

items.name: Baol Organic Plant
items.desc: The Baol Organism had a unique way of producing tools. Given the species' relative slowness, they would simply grow them out of organic matter in locations that were half orchard, half factory. With the proper genetic adjustments, we could also grow various commodities and tools alongside our regular crops.

items.name: Zroni Storm Caster
items.desc: Zro is a fascinating element, prone to chaotic bursts of energy. We believe that with the right artifacts, we could use it to fuel spatial storms over entire solar systems.

items.name: Ancient Suspension Field
items.desc: Projected farther than regular shields, the suspension field technology uses ancient artifacts to slow time at the point of impact to afford the shields a longer opportunity to dispel the incoming attack's energy.

items.name: Ancient Pulse Armor
items.desc: Ionized plates of armor can carry a reactive charge to alleviate the energy of impacts, using magnetic repulsion and field projection principles.

items.name: Ancient Target Scrambler
items.desc: Ping repeaters and optic diffusers with the right wavelengths can produce destructive interference and effectively scramble hostile targeting systems.

items.name: Ancient Ruination Glare
items.desc: Tremendous medium range firepower will enable our titans to break through enemy lines. These ancient cannons were once the foundation upon which a galactic empire was built.

items.name: Devolving Beam
items.desc: A colossal mind-wiping cannon which unleashes a planet-wide wave of energy, returning most sentient life to a pre-sapient state. We estimate that with additional tuning, it might also be used to wipe clean memory banks and disable robotic units.

items.name: Ancient Macro Batteries
items.desc: These cannons of gargantuan size deliver relatively slow but devastating projectiles, and can fire pretty much anything, from scrap metal, to asteroid chunks.

items.name: Ancient Cavitation Collapser
items.desc: This high energy weapon causes brutal micro collapsing events on impact, generating tremendous heat and force inside its targets armor.

items.name: Ancient Defensive Web Slinger
items.desc: When it comes to tracking and shooting down missiles, these antique batteries are the best of the best, making use of a predictive algorithm written in long forgotten code to weave a fiery defensive web.

items.name: Ancient Nano-Missile Cloud Launcher
items.desc: Particle charges, once stabilized thanks to ancient technology, allow us to create swarms of tiny missiles that still carry a respectable payload, and should be able to overwhelm most point-defense systems.

items.name: Ancient Saturator Artillery
items.desc: This cannon fires a barrage of ancient miniscule ionized spheres that charge upon contact with most force fields, giving them high levels of shield penetration. Any theory that these spheres could have been used for jewelry purposes were dismissed when a critical incident melted an entire laboratory.

items.name: Ancient Driller Drones
items.desc: These high velocity drones have been equipped with antique mining lasers that virtually ignore any plating protecting their target. A tech too good to be wasted on astro mining.

items.name: Ancient Rampart
items.desc: Defense platforms are a cost effective way to ensure our safety, but they need to be monitored from an operation center. Fortifying our Starbase to ensure its survivability in the event of an attack, and maximizing our capacity to network independent orbital defenses would give us more time to dispatch reinforcements.

items.name: Ancient Shield Overcharger
items.desc: Supercharging shields can be done safely thanks to ancient stabilizer coils and dampeners. In addition to the production of a stronger force field, this also has the added benefit of outright vaporizing certain incoming projectiles.

items.name: Ancient Refinery
items.desc: This millennia-old processing equipment has an efficiency rate above 100%. Its functioning remains alien, but its production gains are substantial.

items.name: Colossi
items.desc: Advances in mega-engineering blur the lines between reality and fantasy in the form of Colossus-type military vessels. These immense, single-weapon platforms are capable of radically altering or obliterating entire worlds at the push of a button.

items.name: Core Cracking
items.desc: A directed feed of thermic energy superheats the atmosphere and agitates the planet's core, setting up disastrous tectonic events. A final and comparatively minute concussive blast is then delivered, cracking the planet open.

items.name: Global Pacification
items.desc: A shielding field is deployed around a planet, creating a barrier that is permanent and impenetrable (save for some wavelengths of light).

items.name: Neutron Sweeping
items.desc: An accelerated plume of neutron radiation "paints" the planet surface, severely degrading most materials and directly destroying biological tissue.

items.name: Divine Stimulus
items.desc: An arcane catalyst amplifying certain psionic wavelengths, capable of inducing hallucinations (religious experiences) in biological brains, and severe disruption (brain death) in electronic ones.

items.name: Atmospheric Nanobot Dispersal
items.desc: Swarms of nanobots are dispersed in the atmosphere. They infect sapient beings and restructure themselves into cybernetic implants, turning their unwitting hosts into cyborgs slaved to the Machine Intelligence.

items.name: Star Cracker
items.desc: A beam of directed tachyon energy is fired into the star, triggering a supernova. The incredible energy released by this event is then used to generate vast quantities of dark matter.\n\n§RWhen the star detonates, ALL colonies, megastructures, and stations in the system are destroyed - including our own. All fleets in the system will go MIA. The Star-Eater itself is the only exception.§!

items.name: Planet Smelting
items.desc: Focusing a searing energy beam into the planet's mantle, the Smelter destabilizes its core, triggering tectonic chaos and rendering the surface violently unstable.

items.name: Rift Sphere
items.desc: It seems that space and time tend to gather together in layers, all laid on top of one another. The trick is how to slip between the folds.

items.name: Astral Harvesting
items.desc: The harvesting of torn astral fabric along the scars of rifts in space and time is made possible with delicate modifications to our research stations.

items.name: Maulers
items.desc: Breakthroughs in bio-engineering have allowed the growth of space-faring, FTL-capable craft with military applications.

items.name: Standardized Mauler Incubation
items.desc: These incubation chambers accelerate the gestation of embryonic warships within nutrient-dense biopods. Though rudimentary, they mark the first step toward a fleet that is not constructed, but grown.

items.name: Improved Mauler Development
items.desc: Refined incubation processes reduce maturation times and improve structural integrity of organic starships. Enhanced nutrient delivery systems and genetic tuning ensure the vessels are both swift and resilient.

items.name: Advanced Mauler Development
items.desc: These facilities yield vessels of unparalleled vitality and adaptive capacity. Optimized genetic matrices and advanced biotechnological support guarantee unmatched performance in the void.

items.name: Weavers
items.desc: Building on the foundations of early bio-engineering, Weavers are crafted to balance agility with increased combat capabilities.

items.name: Standardized Weaver Incubation
items.desc: These facilities nurture mid-sized biological ships within refined biopods, employing enhanced nutrient delivery and genetic optimization to produce agile and adaptable vessels for the fleet.

items.name: Improved Weaver Development
items.desc: These facilities employ enhanced bio-engineering techniques to accelerate growth cycles and enhance vessel adaptability. Improved genetic matrices and optimized environments ensure these biological ships are both durable and highly responsive in combat.

items.name: Advanced Weaver Development
items.desc: These facilities produce biological ships of unparalleled precision and versatility. Revolutionary growth techniques and adaptive genetic enhancements result in vessels that thrive in even the most demanding tactical scenarios.

items.name: Harbingers
items.desc: Harbingers represent a significant leap in bio-engineered warfare, blending formidable firepower with the resilience of living technology. These ships serve as the backbone of the fleet.

items.name: Standardized Harbinger Incubation
items.desc: These facilities nurture large biological ships, feeding them through advanced nutrient infusion to ensure resilience and combat readiness.

items.name: Improved Harbinger Development
items.desc: Refined facilities employ sophisticated bio-engineering techniques to accelerate growth and enhance structural integrity. The resulting vessels feature improved endurance and increased combat efficiency.

items.name: Advanced Harbinger Development
items.desc: Advanced incubation systems produce biological ships of exceptional durability and firepower. Genetic fine-tuning and superior growth environments create vessels capable of dominating the battlefield with unmatched resilience.

items.name: Stingers
items.desc: Stingers are designed to deliver devastating strikes against high-value targets. They excel in exploiting weaknesses in enemy defenses.

items.name: Standardized Stinger Incubation
items.desc: These facilities grow sleek, agile biological ships designed for precision and speed. Employing advanced biopods and specialized nutrient solutions, they produce vessels capable of precise and efficient strikes.

items.name: Improved Stinger Development
items.desc: Refined facilities accelerate growth cycles and improve bio-engineered precision, resulting in vessels with superior maneuverability and accuracy. These enhancements make the Stinger a devastating force in tactical engagements.

items.name: Advanced Stinger Development
items.desc: The apex of bioship growth technology, these advanced facilities produce Stingers of unmatched speed and lethality. Optimized genetic templates and cutting-edge incubation techniques ensure these ships dominate any battlefield with swift and deadly precision.

items.name: Growth Chamber
items.desc: The construction of Growth Chambers enables the organic cultivation of biological ships within the fleet.

items.name: Advanced Growth Chamber
items.desc: The enhanced efficiency and capacity of Growth Chambers accelerates the cultivation of biological ships by refining their organic designs.

swaps.name: Advanced Growth Chamber
swaps.desc: The enhanced efficiency and capacity of Growth Chambers accelerates the cultivation of biological ships by refining their organic designs.

items.name: Composite Mandibles
items.desc: These devastating appendages incorporate layered organic structures to enhance durability and cutting power, shredding even the toughest defenses.

items.name: Crystalline Mandibles
items.desc: These mandibles possess unparalleled sharpness and resilience, capable of slicing through advanced alloys with unnerving precision.

items.name: Spore Launcher
items.desc: Regenerative pods are launched to deliver strong healing compounds to allied ships.

items.name: Improved Spore Launcher
items.desc: Highly efficient pods imbued with healing biomatter are deployed to rapidly repair damage across multiple vessels.

items.name: Advanced Spore Launcher
items.desc: Pods containing repair agents are launched, optimizing healing based on the severity of damage and ensuring no vulnerabilities remain.

items.name: Adaptive Spore Launcher
items.desc: Pods that saturate the battlefield with adaptive spores provide smart healing to all allied vessels within range.

items.name: Intelligent Adaptive Spore Launcher
items.desc: Deploys pods that unleash a wave of intelligent microorganisms, capable of revitalizing even the most damaged fleets.

items.name: Rebirth Spores
items.desc: Pods filled with malleable cells are launched to trigger the growth of new hull tissues, pushing the endurance of organic vessels beyond their former limits.

items.name: Energy Burster
items.desc: Fires bio-projectiles that emit bursts of energy upon impact, subtly enhancing the maneuverability of our vessels.

items.name: Tangler Pod Launcher
items.desc: Releases concentrated bio-energetic fields, further boosting the evasion capabilities of our ships.

items.name: Agile Spike Array
items.desc: Launches intelligent bio-projectiles that adaptively enhance agility, ensuring superior evasion even in the most chaotic battles.

items.name: Electro Sprayer
items.desc: Deploys advanced munitions that generate dynamic bio-electric auras, significantly improving the ability of ships to evade enemy fire.

items.name: Evasion Darts
items.desc: Fires highly advanced projectiles that create large-scale enhancement fields, granting unparalleled evasion to fleets.

items.name: Adaptive Tendrils
items.desc: Fires bio-munitions that emit fields of adaptive energy, allowing fleets to dance effortlessly out of harm's way.

items.name: Weaver Biofield Generators
items.desc: Fires organic projectiles that emit energizing biofields, subtly increasing the firing speed of weapons systems.

items.name: Weaver Booster Blaster
items.desc: Refined bio-munitions enhance biofield intensity, further accelerating the rate of fire.

items.name: Weaver Organo-Tech Amplifier
items.desc: Deploys adaptive bio-projectiles that amplify reaction times and system efficiency, enabling a significant increase in fire rate.

items.name: Weaver Aura Caster
items.desc: Generates dynamic bio-electric auras, vastly enhancing firing speed across multiple vessels, ensuring relentless pressure on enemy fleets.

items.name: Weaver Swift Shooter
items.desc: Unleashes hyper-charged bio-munitions that create large-scale enhancement fields, enabling fleets to unleash sustained, rapid-fire barrages.

items.name: Weaver Wave Maker
items.desc: Projects waves of bio-energy that push our weaponry to their peak performance, flooding the battlefield with devastating firepower.

items.name: Gloom Spores
items.desc: Organic projectiles imbued with destabilizing enzymes scramble enemy targeting systems and reduce their accuracy.

items.name: Tangle Pulse
items.desc: Refined biological compounds disrupt targeting systems and short-range communications, sowing chaos among enemy ranks.

items.name: Neuro Scourge
items.desc: Adaptive bio-munitions are deployed to exploit neural weaknesses in both organic and synthetic crews, crippling enemy efficiency.

items.name: Ruin Barbs
items.desc: Intelligent bio-projectiles emit disruptive fields on impact, scrambling enemy targeting systems and causing widespread malfunctions.

items.name: Snare Darts
items.desc: Advanced biological ordnance creates a cascading feedback loop within enemy systems, rendering their attacks wildly ineffective.

items.name: Havoc Storm
items.desc: Bio-electromagnetic pulses incapacitate targeting systems and leave fleets in a state of disarray.

items.name: Vector Lock Cannon
items.desc: Biologically enhanced projectiles are fired, countering evasive maneuvers and striking agile targets.

items.name: Enzymatic Webcaster
items.desc: Fires refined projectiles with superior tracking enzymes and adaptive flight paths, increasing hit rates against fast-moving targets.

items.name: Seeker Shard Array
items.desc: Deploys self-guided bio-munitions that lock onto movement patterns, ensuring accuracy against elusive enemies.

items.name: Pinion Accelerator
items.desc: Utilizes complex organic targeting systems that anticipate evasive actions, making even the most agile prey vulnerable.

items.name: Prey Tracker
items.desc: Fires intelligent bio-projectiles equipped with predictive tracking, overcoming the most sophisticated evasion protocols.

items.name: Precision Lancer
items.desc: Deploys bio-plasma rounds that adapt mid-flight, guaranteeing hits against even the most erratic maneuvers.

items.name: Reload Jammer
items.desc: Launches organic projectiles that release specialized enzymes, interfering with enemy weapon reloading systems and reducing their rate of fire.

items.name: Fire Disrupter
items.desc: Enhances disruption enzymes to interfere more effectively with reloading cycles, significantly delaying enemy volleys.

items.name: Mind Missiles
items.desc: Deploys intelligent bio-projectiles that target critical reloading systems, creating cascading delays across enemy fleets.

items.name: Degradation Beams
items.desc: Utilizes adaptive biological compounds that degrade reloading mechanisms, halving the firing efficiency of even the most advanced weaponry.

items.name: Fiend Disabler
items.desc: Fires advanced munitions that emit suppression fields, crippling enemy reloading systems and rendering them painfully slow.

items.name: Tracker Stopper
items.desc: Releases a biological pulse that locks down enemy reloading for extended periods.

items.name: Deep Space Citadel
items.desc: A §YDeep Space Citadel§! is an armored Starbase designed for maximum defense within a stellar gravity well.

items.name: Planetary Germination
items.desc: To spread our roots to a new world first requires us to prepare the seedbed. By first terraforming a planet we can ensure that our colonies are off to a healthy start.

items.name: Storm Manipulation
items.desc: By harnessing the principles behind storm negation technologies, we can begin to manipulate the astrometeorological nature of the galaxy to serve our own needs.

items.name: Advanced Storm Manipulation
items.desc: Continued study into astrometeorology grants us the power to more precisely bend and manipulate §YCosmic Storms§! to our own needs.

items.name: Planetary Storm Negation
items.desc: This nexus of weather communication mitigates the harm done by cosmic weather disasters. Production will suffer less from a passing galactic tempest.

items.name: Cosmic Weather Models
items.desc: Through the use of scientific weather models, we can track the movement and formation of impending §YCosmic Storms§!.

items.name: Probability Current
items.desc: By applying probability currents to our scientific weather models, our ability to track the movement and formation of impending §YCosmic Storms§! is greatly increased.

items.name: Storm Dampening Generators
items.desc: These dampening field generators offer much needed protection to ships traversing cosmic storms.

items.name: Storm Breaker Coating
items.desc: This special coating charges the ship's exterior with a storm dampening field, leading to more efficient protection against storms.

items.name: Payload Padding
items.desc: A new approach to alloy use in military applications significantly reduces the ability of cosmic storms to interfere with energy weaponry and explosive payloads.

items.name: Tempest Cage Architecture
items.desc: This novel approach to ship architecture will significantly reduce the negative effects cosmic storms have on our weapon systems.

items.name: Gargantuan Evolution
items.desc: Voidspawn eggs have evolved to withstand the harsh conditions of space by absorbing and conserving energy from their nearest star.

items.name: Speculative Hyperlane Breaching
items.desc: Solitary Science Ships can break out of the naturally-occurring hyperlanes and attempt to navigate to known but otherwise unreachable destinations.

items.name: Neural Tissue Engineering
items.desc: When tailored to a species' genome, this form of tissue engineering has intensive neuroregenerative properties, significantly increasing the development of neurons, axons, and synapses in its recipient.

items.desc: Advances in solar panel technology could offset the operating costs of our starbases. The panels would require an entire starbase module to generate enough energy, however.

items.desc: The FTL breakthrough allowed early attempts to adapt traditional surface-to-space shuttle frames to military applications to finally create relatively small, fast, and maneuverable vessels with limited firepower.

items.name: Battleships
items.desc: The largest of the standard military vessels, Battleships are traditionally heavily armored and sport several gun batteries.

items.name: Starbase Construction
items.desc: A centralized space installation built in close orbit around the system primary is necessary to make full use of the resources in a star system.

items.name: Starport
items.desc: The earliest starbases were little more than makeshift outposts. Permanent starports will enable us to maintain a firmer grip on star systems.

items.name: Starhold
items.desc: As space traffic increases, larger and more defensible starbases are needed to maintain control over system spacelanes.

items.name: Star Fortress
items.desc: These mighty space forts will provide a focal point for all military activity in a star system, and their presence is sure to deter all but the most stubborn attackers.

items.name: Citadel
items.desc: Plans for an immense battlestation capable of holding its own against several strike fleets are now being drawn up. If realized, these citadels will become monuments to greatness as much as system hubs.

items.name: Orbital Habitats
items.desc: Allows the construction of largely self-sustaining Orbital Habitats.

items.name: Habitat Expansion
items.desc: Our early habitats were primitive things compared to the efficient designs we can now develop.

items.name: Advanced Space Habitation
items.desc: Years of improvements to our §YOrbital Habitats§! have led us to create newer more effective designs.

items.name: Modular Engineering
items.desc: Streamlined starbase construction procedures, using modular designs, will reduce the present build cost and time.

items.name: Corps of Engineers
items.desc: The creation of a dedicated naval engineering corps will greatly benefit the construction of deep space defense platforms, decreasing building costs and increasing durability.

items.name: Carrier Operations
items.desc: These manned strike craft are launched from a mothership and rely on their speed and small size to survive long enough to punch through enemy defenses.

items.name: Improved Strike Craft
items.desc: The next generation of strike craft, featuring improved avionics, better handling characteristics and more powerful armaments.

items.name: Advanced Strike Craft
items.desc: A further refinement in strike craft design, these advanced strike craft are a pilot's dream. Their performance far exceeds that of previous models.

items.name: Skravird Strike Craft
items.desc: Learning from the design expertise of Skrand and his people, these superior strike craft are capable of prolonged engagement and highly adaptive tactics.

items.name: Interplanetary Expeditionary Forces
items.desc: The invasion of another world is a staggering enterprise. There are immense logistical challenges that must be overcome before we can muster our first interplanetary armies.

items.name: Nanocomposite Materials
items.desc: Reinforced nanocomposite hull plating can provide an extra layer of protection that could be the difference between life and death in a combat situation.

items.desc: A combination of different metals and ceramics that result in a strong armor without sacrificing flexibility.

items.name: Plasteel Materials

items.name: Durasteel Materials
items.desc: This strong yet flexible material is capable of withstanding severe punishment. It serves well as ship armor.

items.name: Neutronium Materials
items.desc: This incredibly dense and strong material can resist firepower that would turn armor made of any other alloys into slag.

items.name: Crystal-Infused Plating
items.desc: By infusing armor plating with Crystalline matter we are able to further increase the durability of our ships' protective hulls.

items.name: Crystal-Forged Plating
items.desc: Introducing Crystalline matter into the forging process further improves the ultra-hard qualities of crystal-infused metals.

items.name: Adaptive Armor Hardening
items.desc: Threads of living metal react to incoming fire, rearranging itself to better resist penetrating weapons fire.

swaps.name: Chemical Stellar Motor Organs
swaps.desc: Through a combination of muscles, fins, and chemical exhausts this ship is capable of sublight travel.

items.name: Ion Thrusters

swaps.name: Ion Stellar Motor Organs
swaps.desc: An array of electrically charged organs accelerate ions to generate thrust.

items.name: Plasma Thrusters
items.desc: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.

swaps.name: Plasma Stellar Motor Organs
swaps.desc: Further refinements of the electrical capabilities of the motor organs allow for greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.

swaps.name: Impulse Stellar Motor Organs

items.name: Nanomechanics

items.desc: Much as organic neurons reforge lost connections by means of axonal sprouting, these circuits are capable of self-overhaul. Even the simplest computing systems are now expected to evolve while in use.

items.name: Artificial Workforce
items.desc: These artificial work units are perfect for menial labor tasks. They are hard-working and capable of following simple vocal instructions, but should not be expected to climb stairs.

items.name: Artificial Specialists
items.desc: Upgraded artificial units have an expanded movement range equal to that of most organics. Their neural processors have also been greatly improved.

items.name: Artificial Administration
items.desc: Highly advanced units that are stronger, faster and more durable than the vast majority of organics. With their upgraded neural processors they are fully capable of independent operations.

items.name: Artificial Personality Matrix
items.desc: Equipped with a personality, synthetics will finally be able to interact socially on equal terms with the rest of our citizens. Some units may even assume leadership roles.

items.name: Robotic Assembly Systems

items.name: Integrated Cybernetics
items.desc: Improving upon basic exoskeletal suits, these integrated cybernetic implants make the user more resistant to harmful environmental effects.

items.desc: Construction in space presents our engineers with new design challenges that must be solved before we can build orbital stations above other worlds.

swaps.name: Zero-G Engineering

items.name: Railguns

items.name: Advanced Railguns
items.desc: A new version of the venerable railgun, with sturdier rails and an enhanced power supply. These weapons are even more powerful and accurate than their predecessors.

items.name: Gauss Cannons
items.desc: This updated version of the old coilgun design is even more destructive than the latest railgun designs. It is capable of launching projectiles with incredible accuracy and speed.

items.name: Kinetic Battery
items.desc: Very long-range artillery capable of hurling powerful rounds over extreme distances with a large degree of accuracy.

items.name: Kinetic Artillery
items.desc: An even more powerful long-range, ship-based artillery cannon, equipped with a new barrel and an upgraded fire control computer.

items.name: Mega Cannon
items.desc: An enormous mass accelerator cannon that can only be placed in a spinal mount and fires monstrously powerful rounds over vast distances.

items.name: Giga Cannon
items.desc: An even more powerful mass accelerator cannon that can rip through even the toughest shields.

items.name: Autocannons
items.desc: Large-caliber ballistic weapons that fire cased explosive shells. The main advantage of these cannons is their high rate of fire.

swaps.name: Quill Battery
swaps.desc: Sharper quills, fired at increased rates, deliver devastating volleys to overwhelm shields and shred hulls.

items.name: Ripper Cannons
items.desc: These upgraded rotary autocannons feature improved tracking and fire control systems. This allows them to maintain an even higher rate of fire.

swaps.name: Ripper Quill Battery
swaps.desc: Refined biological quills fire with superior velocity to pierce through even hardened defenses.

items.name: Stormfire Cannons
items.desc: Advanced rotary autocannons capable of spewing a cloud of high-explosive shells at a target.

swaps.name: Stormfire Quill Battery
swaps.desc: Hyper-dense quills can be fired at a blistering pace eviscerating shields and carving through heavily armored targets with ease.

items.name: Flak Battery

items.name: Flak Cannons
items.desc: Upgraded flak batteries with new, more powerful shrapnel rounds.

items.name: Flak Artillery
items.desc: Predictive tracking algorithms and even more powerful rounds make these batteries incredibly lethal to enemy strike craft.

items.name: Nuclear Missiles
items.desc: Space-to-space missiles equipped with high-yield nuclear warheads. Although based on old pre-space technology, these crude fire-and-forget weapons can be surprisingly effective at range.

items.name: Fusion Missiles
items.desc: These updated space-to-space missiles have more powerful fusion warheads and improved flight performance.

items.name: Antimatter Missiles
items.desc: Advanced missiles equipped with very powerful antimatter warheads. A new and improved guidance system gives them a better chance of finding their targets.

items.name: Quantum Missiles
items.desc: The latest version of space-to-space missile, this upgraded variant has an immensely powerful warhead that draws its energy from a zero point vacuum.

items.name: Marauder Missiles
items.desc: These highly advanced missiles are equipped with limited onboard AI pilots that substantially improve their performance and ability to track targets.

items.name: Swarmer Missiles
items.desc: These smaller missiles are launched in volleys and have been specifically designed to overwhelm enemy point-defense systems.

swaps.name: Bio-Swarmer Missiles

items.name: Whirlwind Missiles

swaps.name: Bio-Whirlwind Missiles
swaps.desc: New miniaturization techniques will allow us to equip swarmer missiles with more powerful warheads and improved flight performance.

items.name: Space Torpedoes
items.desc: These torpedoes are essentially very large, slow-moving missiles. They are equipped with more powerful warheads and shield modulators that let them slip unmolested through energy screens.

items.name: Armored Torpedoes
items.desc: Upgraded space torpedoes encased in armor, to better withstand enemy point-defense fire. The armor fragments into shards that cause additional damage when the torpedo detonates.

items.name: Devastator Torpedoes
items.desc: Advanced torpedoes with very powerful warheads. They have a sleeker design, faster engines and upgraded shield modulators for slipping through energy screens.

items.name: Pyroclastic Resonation
items.desc: By harnessing the extreme thermal energy found on molten worlds, our starbases can increase the energy output in a system with exceptional efficiency.

items.name: Alloy Fossilization
items.desc: By exposing biological material to simulated chthonian-level radiation, we can fossilize cellular structures into usable metallic alloys.

items.name: Advanced Orbital Maneuvers
items.desc: Sublight travel can be further optimized by performing advanced calculations that make maximum use of planetary gravity wells.

items.name: Frozen World Habitats
items.desc: By harnessing the subthermal dynamics found in the environments of frozen worlds, we can create more hospitable living conditions in colder climates.

items.name: Living Test Subjects
items.desc: The utilization of basic slime-spawned lifeforms as willing test subjects greatly improves research efficiency.

items.name: Georadiation Terraforming
items.desc: By exposing the biosphere of a planet to molecular radiation decay, we promote the growth of certain resources while turning the world into a toxic wasteland.

items.name: Dark Matter Deflectors
items.desc: These deflectors utilize dark matter to deflect incoming projectiles in a way that seems to utterly defy the laws of nature.

items.name: Dark Matter Power
items.desc: These generators appear to somehow draw energy directly from dark matter, providing more ship power than should be possible according to the laws of physics.

items.name: Dark Matter Propulsion
items.desc: These ship thrusters utilize Dark Matter technology to generate propulsion in a manner that appears to defy numerous laws of physics.

swaps.name: Dark Matter Stellar Motor Organs
swaps.desc: Embedded clusters of dark matter within the ship's tissues enable it to "swim" through space, moving in ways that defy conventional physics and our current understanding of propulsion.

items.name: Affluence Emporium
items.desc: This center anticipates and fulfills material desires using an advanced procurement algorithm, delivering satisfaction before the populace realizes their wants.

items.name: Affluence Center
items.desc: This center effortlessly materializes the most outlandish desires at a moment's notice.

items.name: Nourishment Complex
items.desc: Replication technology swiftly conjures up novel flavors on command.

items.name: Nourishment Center
items.desc: Every conceivable flavor can be replicated within these walls.

items.name: Dimensional Replicator
items.desc: This fabricator's technology achieves flawless conversion from energy to matter.

items.name: Dimensional Fabricator
items.desc: This advanced fabricator seamlessly tunnels into the fabric of dimensional space, extracting valuable resources.

items.name: Class-3 Singularity
items.desc: Capturing the entire energy output from this singularity is an engineering marvel.

items.name: Class-4 Singularity
items.desc: This singularity's power output challenges the laws of physics, yet the containment fields hold with unwavering stability.

items.name: Hyper-Forge
items.desc: This forge's production speed is limited only by the quantity of resources loaded into it.

items.name: Auto-Forge
items.desc: The expansive nano-replicator bays in this forge transform raw materials into advanced alloys with marvelous efficiency.

items.name: Sky Dome
items.desc: This floating city, propelled by state-of-the-art anti-gravity technology, provides an idyllic haven for its inhabitants.

items.name: Empyrean Dome
items.desc: Suspended by gravimetric nullification, these domes transcend physical limitations, while advanced life support systems seamlessly cater to inhabitants' needs.

items.name: Aspis Bastion
items.desc: This colossal planetary defense complex has numerous armories and layers of shielding. Only a highly specialized siege force could breach its defenses.

items.name: Aegis Complex
items.desc: This monumental planetary defense complex protects with countless armories and shielding; the planet's mountains will crumble before its defenses.

items.name: Fractal Administration Processes
items.desc: Our administrative requirements will likewise expand as our mastery of advanced technology evolves. We must adeptly cater to the demands of our burgeoning empire.

items.name: Quantic Administration Processes
items.desc: Our technology now surpasses any administrative requirement. The expertise needed to seamlessly govern a galactic empire is firmly within our reach.

items.name: Robot Manufacturing Nexus
items.desc: An avant-garde assembly complex manned by expert Roboticists, this facility transcends conventional bounds, meticulously realizing the forefront of robotic innovation.

items.name: Robot Quantum Production Hub
items.desc: A marvel in engineering, this facility's quantic assembly line uses entanglement converters to craft machine parts down to the most minute detail. Not a single atom is misplaced.

items.name: Molecular-Revitalization Institute
items.desc: Molecular-Revitalization Institutes delve deep into cellular intricacies to amplify the effectiveness of medical treatments, significantly improving the quality and longevity of the populations' health.

items.name: Bioregeneration Institute
items.desc: The Bioregeneration Institute, at the pinnacle of medical technology, pioneers groundbreaking bio-regenerative therapies, continuously redefining the boundaries of life extension.

items.name: Justice Complex
items.desc: This massive judicial complex seamlessly intertwines courts and law enforcement.

items.name: Ziggurat of Justice
items.desc: The zenith of legal institutions, this colossal edifice is a monument to justice, harboring courts, holding facilities, and correctional facilities that will redeem even the most hardened criminals.

items.name: Galactic Commerce Hub
items.desc: Dominating the skyline, these towering spires cast shadows across the bustling trade districts below.

items.name: Interstellar Commerce Nexus
items.desc: Reigning supreme in the galactic economy, the colossal spires of this trade district can be seen from orbit.

items.name: Shrinkspace Depot
items.desc: The depot influences a portion of subspace where the distance between molecules is reduced, effectively shrinking anything stored there. Living beings are forbidden from entering it.

items.name: Extra-Dimensional Depot
items.desc: By creating a localized pocket dimension, we can hold nearly endless resources.

items.name: Virtual Bliss Plaza
items.desc: These immense entertainment sectors are at the forefront of recreation and leisure. Brainwave readers allow for instantaneous and personalized virtual getaways.

items.name: Omni-Bliss Nexus
items.desc: A colossal culmination of entertainment, this nexus transcends conventional limits, where dreams materialize before desires are realized.

items.name: Quantum Innovation Nexus
items.desc: This nexus boasts state-of-the-art equipment and an unprecedented staff capacity, ushering in an era where quantum theories are not just explored but harnessed for groundbreaking innovation.

items.name: Transcendental Innovation Department
items.desc: This building is the apex of scientific advancement and proves this is an era of boundless innovation.

items.name: Quantum Drilling Plant
items.desc: This mining plant can find minerals anywhere in this planet's mantle using quantum tunneling technology to bore through solid materials without physical contact.

items.name: Quantum Drilling Hub
items.desc: This mining hub can extract minerals anywhere down to the planet's outer core using quantum tunneling technology to bore through solid or liquid materials without physical contact.

items.name: Basic Cloaking Fields
items.desc: A modified particle field allows our vessels to effectively 'hide' in open space. However, this comes at the cost of destabilizing other forms of energy shielding which would otherwise protect the ship.

items.name: Advanced Cloaking Fields
items.desc: Advancements in rare crystal lensing technology have greatly improved cloaking efficiency.

items.name: Elite Cloaking Fields
items.desc: Typical cloaking technology can play havoc with a ship's more delicate instruments. However, these elite fields render such concerns obsolete.

items.name: Dark Matter Cloaking Fields
items.desc: This device uses dark matter to warp space-time around the vessel, making it incredibly difficult to detect.

items.name: Psi-Phase Field Generator
items.desc: Psi-Phase Field Generators focus the psionic potential of the ship's crew to partially phase the vessel into the Shroud. This allows the ship to remain undetected by all but the best sensor arrays, though what the crew may be forced to witness is better left unsaid.

items.name: Detection Array
items.desc: A high-powered suite of external sensors, capable of detecting cloaked fleets.\n

items.name: Dark Matter Detection
items.desc: Dark matter resonance chambers will significantly improve the performance of our detection arrays.

items.name: Advanced Detection Algorithms
items.desc: Coupling detection arrays with the computers onboard our science vessels can vastly increase their scanning resolution.

items.name: Subspace Drive
items.desc: An insight borne of a desperate desire to leave our home, these Subspace Drive engines were designed to facilitate limited interstellar travel. While only allowing small-scale jumps, they provide a unique opportunity to jumpstart our galactic exploration.

items.name: Unusual Senses
items.desc: Nothing is more innovative than natural evolution. By studying how pre-FTL societies view their world, we have devised new methods of detecting uninvited ships.

items.name: New Numbers
items.desc: After studying multiple pre-FTL civilizations, we have realized that there are many alternative ways to calculate the universe. It has even introduced new numbers into our mathematics.

items.name: Trinary Computing
items.desc: Different societies have developed alternative solutions for their logistics and computing. These alien ways of thinking have made it easier for us to adapt to foreign empires' structures.

items.name: Atmospheric Orbital Mechanics
items.desc: Due to our vast experience operating observation stations in orbit of pre-FTL worlds, we have discovered slight optimizations. By implementing them empire-wide, we can drastically reduce the maintenance our stations require.

items.desc: Just like how clever pre-FTLs move to conceal each other as they approach an enemy, so too can our pilots move faster without disrupting their cloaking field.

items.name: Satisfying Insults
items.desc: Nothing is quite as powerful as a well-placed insult, and we now know how to insult a species's progenitor in many languages.

items.name: Compact Living
items.desc: While no one civilization has the perfect solution to the ever-expanding challenge of governing a growing nation, we have found a partial solution. After studying a multitude of species and governments, we have discovered an outstanding balance of flexibility and function.

items.name: Alien Topography
items.desc: Civilizations flourish in locations that promotes growth, and by analyzing where the majority of pre-FTL settlements thrive we can gain more out of our colonies.

items.name: Xeno-Aesthetics
items.desc: After analyzing a multitude of artists from drastically different cultures, we have come up with a general theorem. By studying a civilization's art and culture, we can gain an advantage against them in combat.

items.name: Lost Building Methods
items.desc: Any civilization with a long enough history has examples of great wonders built by forgotten ancients which can no longer be replicated. Luckily for us we have documented these great ancients when they appeared on pre-FTL worlds.

items.name: Supreme Alloy
items.desc: What we thought was the greatest alloy turned out to be far from the truth. Countless pre-FTL refining processes have been cataloged, and we have now synthesized an unbeatable metal.

items.name: Ordered Retreat
items.desc: While studying the victors of battles might be the most obvious way to gain insight from combat, observing the loser on pre-FTL worlds has taught us how to organize our withdraws more effectively.

items.name: Temple of Transportation
items.desc: Transportation networks bring people together: a sentiment shared by many civilization we observed. While we do not have steam engines, our hyper relay networks could serve a similar purpose.

items.name: Galactic Archivism
items.desc: The history of our galaxy warrants proper preservation in order to learn from those who came before us. An archive on the grandest scale would fit such a purpose.

items.name: Gravity Snares
items.desc: Localized concentrations of quantum mass can be used to create short bursts of extreme gravity. If manipulated correctly, such a gravitational force could theoretically capture and contain a creature of any size without harm.

items.name: Gravity Manipulation Optimization

items.name: Containment System Improvement
items.desc: Increases the amount of §YSpace Fauna§! captured by Gravity Snares by §G1§!

items.name: Curator Containment Protocols
items.desc: Gravity Snares capture double the amount of §YSpace Fauna§!.

items.name: Voidworm Immunity
items.desc: We can develop a cure for Voidworm parasitic infection. All of our colonies would be rendered immune to their current strain of spore bombardment.

items.name: Asteroidal Carapace
items.desc: The shell of a Cutholoid is not mineral alone, but reinforced with strong biological fibers. We can synthesize this process using advanced metallurgic techniques.

items.name: Artificial Breeding
items.desc: In a carefully controlled environment, we can incubate the Genetic Material collected from culled Space Fauna and produce new members of each species under our command.

items.name: Improved Incubators
items.desc: We can improve the artificial growth processes established in our hatcheries, accelerating the early developmental stages in order to create more mature clones.

items.name: Metabolic Gases
items.desc: Improvements to the metabolic gases within our hatcheries will further mature each specimen before it is brought into this world.

items.name: Boarding Cables
items.desc: Repurposed small-caliber artillery that fire piercing hooks attached to resilient carbon fiber cables, perfect for immobilizing and boarding enemy ships.

items.name: Controlled Mutations
items.desc: We can increase the effectiveness of our Space Fauna Ships by modifying their genomes, allowing us to integrate artificial technology into their biomass.

items.name: Advanced Controlled Mutations
items.desc: We can go further. Advanced manipulation of Space Fauna genetics allows for integrating a wider variety of specialized components.

items.name: Leechcraft
items.desc: Modified Flagella spawn that siphon nutrients and materials from their prey in order to support the regeneration of their host Amoeba.

items.name: Herdsong Chords
items.desc: The somber song of the Tiyanki inspires its fellow creatures, hardening their resolve in combat.

items.name: Virulent Cysts
items.desc: Cysts filled with reproductive fluid allow for each Voidworm in a fertile Troika to independently produce spawn when bombarding an inhabited planet.

items.name: Gastric Fountain
items.desc: The powerful digestive system of a Cutholoid can be repurposed to fire kinetic projectiles at extremely high velocity.

items.name: Fissile Cores
items.desc: Redundant thought centers allow for a Crystalline Entity to split itself in two as a final gambit to protect its clutch against a particularly dangerous foe.

items.name: Restorative Enzymes
items.desc: On death, the Tiyanki Matriarch produces an assortment of protective chemicals in a final attempt to preserve the lives of her remaining kin.

items.name: Starborne Biology
items.desc: A main source of energy for large creatures in deep space comes from the power of starlight. The closer they are to brighter stars, the faster they develop.

items.name: Thruster Bio-integration
items.desc: Artificial thrusters can be integrated into spaceborne organisms with appropriate considerations for energy supply and connections to neural motor centers.

items.name: Hyperdrive Bio-integration
items.desc: Traveling across hyperlanes can be hazardous for spaceborne life, but we are able to enhance their capabilities.

items.name: Sensor Bio-integration
items.desc: The diverse sensory organs of spaceborne life can be enhanced by our developed technologies with minimal harm to the organism.

items.name: Combat Computer Bio-integration
items.desc: We can develop specialized neurochips to influence the behavior of space fauna involved in wide scale fleet combat.

items.name: Entropic Recursion
items.desc: The universe tends irresistibly onwards and downwards. That tendency cannot be reversed... but it can be subverted, for a price.

items.name: Doctrine: Strange Loop
items.desc: A set of social protocols based on paradoxical intuition, and on love. When we know the System of the Loop, we learn that we can influence by receiving instructions, as well as giving them.

items.name: Omega Theory
items.desc: When a temporal paradox becomes tangled, a kind of consciousness arises, with its own needs, its own desires. This is what has occurred with the consciousness that some call the Worm-in-Waiting. If we can align ourselves with that consciousness, we might just achieve a kind of immortality.

items.name: Artificial Dragonscales
items.desc: The Ether Drake's scales are made up of multiple layers of unique mineral nanostructures. Unorthodox manufacturing techniques allow us to closely emulate these self-repairing structures.

items.name: Enigmatic Encoder
items.desc: The Enigmatic Encoder scrambles flight path data according to some indeterminable design before feeding it back to fleet command.
items.weight_modifier: factor = 0

items.name: Enigmatic Decoder
items.desc: While producing average results in standard tests, the accuracy of Enigmatic Decoder's prediction algorithms seemingly increases as the target's flight path grows more erratic.

items.name: Identity Copies
items.desc: We will be able to copy the identity and memories of a Synthetic into a new mechanical body. The copies have predictable skill sets but make for stale conversation.

items.name: Identity Fusion
items.desc: Merging the identities and memories of two or more Synthetics into a mechanical body will create new, somewhat unique individuals.

items.name: Identity Initialization
items.desc: We will be able to initialize an identity kernel and provide it with a virtual childhood. While expensive, we can simulate the optimal experiences to generate productive personalities.

items.name: Cetana's Thought
items.desc: This compendium, a gift from Cetana, is a tapestry of profound insights, elegantly composed and dense with meaning. It offers more than knowledge; it challenges and reshapes our understanding of technology, society, and the fabric of consciousness itself.

items.name: Exponential Learning Theory
items.desc: The radical shift in perspective required to comprehend the infinite layers of reality challenges even our most brilliant minds.

items.name: Gravitic Brush
items.desc: Gravity and spacetime shape the universe. Starting with gravity, we will master tools to power our ascension.

items.name: Theoretical Infinity Thesis
items.desc: Precise and incredibly minute alterations in gravity allow us to inject commands into the code of reality. Extreme caution is imperative as we learn the applications of this new and incredible tool.

items.name: The Rules of Reality
items.desc: Recent experiments confirm that our edits to reality are only temporary. More significant alterations will be necessary to anchor these changes.

items.name: Nascent Universes
items.desc: Large-scale travel to different universes is a daunting task. We must engineer a spacecraft that can not only pierce the fabric of spacetime but also survive the journey.\n\n§RFallen Empires will try to stop us!§!

items.name: Riddle Escort
items.desc: A starship of modest size that optimizes our knowledge of spacetime to enact dimensional transcendentalism, making the inside bigger than its outward shape suggests. Advanced firepower capabilities come at a reduced logistical cost compared to traditional ship designs.

items.name: Enigma Battlecruiser
items.desc: Another optimized spacecraft, this time of larger dimensions, will make current Battleships look like toys.

items.name: Paradox Titan
items.desc: These formidable ships are closer to mobile fortresses than anything else, and only the most brutal assaults have a chance to damage them.

items.name: Quandary Weaver
items.desc: Equipped with support weapon arrays that outstrip its visible anatomy, the Quandary Weaver rewrites spatial norms. Alone, it can shift the momentum of entire battles.

items.name: Cipher Mauler
items.desc: Through organic spacetime-dimensional transcendentalism, this Mauler is larger on the inside its compact frame concealing a dense tangle of musculature. Capable of a bite deadlier than physics should allow.

items.name: Maze Harbinger
items.desc: These Harbingers nest their strike craft in interwoven pocket dimensions, each ship a labyrinth of impossible hangars, capable of deploying a fleet's worth of firepower.

items.name: Cryptic Stinger
items.desc: Brimming with more weapon systems than its power source should sustain, this Stinger shouldn't function, and yet, it fires. Continuously.

items.name: Scalable Reservoir Computing
items.desc: Colossal in scale, the Synaptic Lathe is a reservoir computer. The processing power of our population's networked minds is used to compute and store data. The benefits are obvious, but some misguided species may view the transmutation of individuals into computing chips as morally questionable.

items.name: Applied Infinity Thesis
items.desc: By making further alterations to reality's rules, we can better monitor its reactions. At this scale, the effects are still difficult to predict, and could affect the entire galaxy.

items.name: Synaptic Resonator
items.desc: Resonators harness and redirect the cognitive potential of stray thoughts and autonomic systems, leading every single chip to increase the efficiency of its closest processing neighbors.

items.name: Synaptic Overclocker
items.desc: The Lathe has been designed to preserve its installed Neural Chips, keeping them productive for as long as possible. The overclocker can override these commands, resulting in a higher and faster output, but it comes with an increased failure rate.

items.name: Synaptic Preserver
items.desc: The organic components of the network are especially vulnerable to energetic fluctuations, which can cause rapid axonal degeneration. The Preserver strives to reduce these fluctuations to protect the Synaptic Lathe's frailer parts.

items.name: Arc Furnace
items.desc: Utilizing the raw power of a molten planet, the §YArc Furnace§! unlocks otherwise inaccessible minerals and improves system-wide mining operations.

items.name: Dyson Swarm
items.desc: An array of interlinked satellites, the §YDyson Swarm§! is designed to improve the output of stellar deposits.

items.name: Cetana's Nanites
items.desc: Cetana's advanced nanite systems will tirelessly repair and refresh our ships at a rate far beyond our current capabilities.

items.name: Orbital Trash Dispersal
items.desc: This orbital bombardment management system spams a planet with millions of minute, high-velocity projectiles, overwhelming planetside defensive grids with trash data. Ships equipped with this component will cause more damage during orbital bombardment.

items.name: Xeno Outreach Agencies
items.desc: This corporate agency promotes a wide variety of interstellar tourist attractions, as well as offering employment packages and signing bonuses to potential emigrants interested in relocating to corporate space.

items.name: Executive Leisure Program
items.desc: A luxurious resort complex for high ranking corporate officers. Here they can sample the local culture in a high security environment.

items.name: Mega-Engineering
items.desc: To complete construction projects of truly staggering scales we must first achieve a fundamental understanding of both the engineering and resource storage requirements for such megastructures.

items.name: Science Nexus
items.desc: The research labs and databanks of a §YScience Nexus§! generate an immense flow of raw, undiluted science.

items.name: Sentry Array
items.desc: The stages of the §YSentry Array§! gradually expand sensor range, eventually covering the entire galaxy.

items.name: Strategic Coordination Center
items.desc: A facility synchronizing the national Starbase network, augmenting defensive and offensive capabilities.

items.name: Interstellar Assembly
items.desc: A meeting place for galactic powers, increasing immigration attraction and global opinion of us.

items.name: Mega Art Installation
items.desc: An artistic beacon on a stellar scale, this installation inspires and represents the spirit of its creators.

items.name: Gateway Activation
items.desc: The ability to reactivate the derelict Gateway stations that can be found scattered throughout the galaxy has the potential to dramatically shorten travel times.

items.name: Gateway Construction
items.desc: The construction of new Gateway stations enables us to build a fast-travel network that could revolutionize interstellar travel.

items.name: Dyson Sphere
items.desc: A §YDyson Sphere§! fully envelops a given star, converting all solar output directly to £energy£ Energy Credits.

items.name: Matter Decompressor
items.desc: The §YMatter Decompressor§! lenses a black hole's gravity, forming a drill of gravitational forces to retrieve £minerals£ Minerals from the singularity.

items.name: Ring Segment
items.desc: A §YRing Segment§! allows for multiple planet-like zones, cannibalizing all other planets in the system for materials.

items.name: Mega Shipyard
items.desc: A zero-G construction yard of overwhelming proportion, capable of performing several space ship assembly projects simultaneously.

items.name: Arkship Construction
items.desc: Our society need not be limited to one home. With the ability to construct additional Arkships, every direction becomes a path, and every path becomes ours.

items.name: Arkship Engineering
items.desc: Refined structural design and improved drive systems allow for a new generation of Arkships: carrying more of who we are, further than we have ever gone.

items.name: Arkship Mastery
items.desc: The pinnacle of mobile megastructure engineering. These Arkships represent the full extent of what a traveling civilization can achieve.

items.name: Civilian Arkships
items.desc: More than a vessel, the Civilian Arkship is a world unto itself. Its infrastructure supports a complete society in motion, carrying with it everything needed to thrive across the stars.

items.name: Scientific Arkships
items.desc: Scientific Arkships combine the mobility of nomadic life with the full resources of a dedicated research institution, turning every system we visit into a new opportunity for discovery.

items.name: Military Arkships
items.desc: Military Arkships are the armored core of a nomadic empire. Purpose-built for combat, they carry devastating firepower wherever the fleet travels.

items.name: Planetary Reprocessor
items.desc: Smaller celestial bodies can be crushed and processed in these enormous gears, providing us with a bounty of materials.

items.name: Stellar Engine
items.desc: A dark matter injection system capable of triggering stellar-scale fusion events. It has no safe setting.

items.name: Subspace Imaging Array
items.desc: The void speaks, and for those who know to listen, it whispers the secrets of the countless worlds in its embrace.

items.name: Exodus Jump Coordinator
items.desc: The Exodus Coordinator is still largely a prototype that will one day enable us to cross to different galaxies in the blink of an eye.

items.name: Strategic Extraction
items.desc: The extraction of strategic resources is a fundamental requirement for arkship operations.

items.name: Waystations
items.desc: §YWaystations§! collect celestial resources and form interstellar trade routes.

items.name: Improved Wayline Logistics
items.desc: Our Waystations are no longer simple markers along the stars. Improved logistics allow them to store greater reserves and transfer resources more efficiently along established Waylines.

items.desc: Allows us to shoot our energy stockpile at targeted systems

items.name: Quantum Catapult
items.desc: A §YQuantum Catapult§! harnesses the power of a Neutron Star or Pulsar to twist the fabric of space, skipping a fleet across great distances.

items.name: Orbital Rings
items.desc: Allows the construction of massive, band-shaped starbases in stable orbit around colonized planets.

items.name: Hyper Relays
items.desc: §YHyper Relays§! form a chain of structures built outside the gravity well of systems, allowing fast travel from relay to relay rather than requiring transit to established hyperlane entrances.

items.name: Space Exploration
items.desc: The realization of faster-than-light travel is a new dawn for space exploration. Manned missions to other star systems are now not only possible, but necessary.

items.name: Scientific Method
items.desc: Testable predictions of observable phenomena.

items.name: Quantum Computing
items.desc: With processing speeds that defy classical limits, the potential of quantum computers is boundless. This revolutionary technology heralds a great leap into uncharted regions of problem-solving.

items.name: Unified Field Theory
items.desc: The fundamental forces of the universe can be mediated by physical fields. Mastering this process allows us to play as gods - at least within the confines of the science lab.

items.name: Quantum Gravitational Waves
items.desc: We knew gravity and time were linked long before we reached the stars. Now, our understanding of this unique relationship has reached a tipping point, allowing us to manipulate forces on a previously unimaginable scale.

items.name: Administrative AI
items.desc: Organizational circuitry rerouting academic fervor.

items.name: Automated Colony Ships
items.desc: By giving control of the colony ship to the on-board computer, the crew and colonists can be placed in suspended animation.

swaps.name: Seedling Incubation
swaps.desc: By first incubating our new seedlings in the native soils of new colonies we can speed up the acclimatization process.

items.name: Self-Aware Colony Ships
items.desc: Sufficiently advanced systems are capable of optimizing themselves if they are made acutely aware of the purpose for which they were made.

swaps.name: Permanent Incubation
swaps.desc: Permanently maintaining specialized seedlings capable of surviving all types of climates massively decreases the time it takes us to create new worlds.

items.name: Self-Evolving Logic
items.desc: Introspective prioritization.

items.name: Automated Exploration Protocols
items.desc: An advanced AI will aid science officers in their task to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations, to boldly go where no Blorg has gone before. The Science Ship will be able to explore the galaxy with help from an AI.

items.name: Positronic AI
items.desc: Evolving artificial intellects are opening the door to the possibility for true synthetic sapience.

items.name: Positronic Implants
items.desc: Expanding possibilities through the application of limited cybernetics.

items.name: Specialized Combat Computers
items.desc: Active matrices tuned for specific combat-centric tasks greatly improve engagement efficiency.

items.name: Extended Combat Algorithms
items.desc: Further advances in predictive algorithms allow for augmented tactical decision-making in the field.

items.name: Sapient Combat Simulations
items.desc: Running sapient AIs through high-intensity combat simulations yields valuable insight into potential optimizations for risk-evaluation techniques.

items.name: Autonomous Ship Intellects
items.desc: Granting our ships their own semi-autonomous intellect will greatly enhance their responsiveness in combat.

items.name: Auxiliary Fire-control
items.desc: By installing an auxiliary fire-control system our ships can afford to make more advanced calculations, increasing accuracy.

items.name: Synchronized Defenses
items.desc: Aligning defensive and offensive weapon execution paradigms allows for increased efficiency.

items.name: Market Analysis Algorithms
items.desc: Basic administrative AIs can be used to streamline supply and demand lines, reducing waste.

items.name: Quantum Hacking
items.desc: Primitive encryption systems stand no chance against modern decryption tools.

items.desc: The weakest link in any security system are the individuals within it. By modeling their weaknesses in computer simulations we can find novel ways to bypass their security - or trick them into bypassing it for us.

items.name: Quasi-Dimensional Reflection
items.desc: Our operatives can access data from adjacent realities without risking setting off alarms in this reality.

items.name: Cold Fusion Power
items.desc: The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.

items.name: Antimatter Power
items.desc: By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.

items.name: Shields

items.name: Advanced Shields

items.name: Hyper Shields

items.name: Focused Arc Emitters

items.name: Ion Disruptors

items.name: Phase Disruptors
items.desc: Extremely high-yield disruptors that fire quantum energy charges causing incredible damage to those unfortunate enough to get in their way.

items.name: Proton Launchers

items.name: Neutron Launchers

items.name: Active Countermeasures
items.desc: The best defense is a good offense.

items.name: Interlinked Support Systems
items.desc: Arrays of defensive armaments prove much more effective than independent countermeasures.

items.name: Predictive Algorithms
items.desc: Advanced prediction greatly increases the accuracy of active countermeasure systems.

items.name: Extradimensional Weaponry
items.desc: Applying 5th-dimensional energy manipulation principles on lower dimensional planes allows for the creation of powerful energy weapons.

items.name: Mining Drone Lasers
items.desc: Using intense-focus lenses in combination with an oscillating firing frequency help create lasers strong enough to mine asteroids, or shoot down hostiles.

items.name: Cloud Lightning Conduits
items.desc: Void Clouds use the electrical charges generated by the dense gases that make up most of their core to release bolts of burning plasma. Using the same gas composition together with a specialized conduit allows for powerful lightning weaponry.

items.name: Null Void Beam
items.desc: By harnessing the entropic nature of the Null Void, this beam can actually destroy energy.

items.name: Starfire Cannon
items.desc: Like any potential hazard, the dangerous radiation from our star's transformation can also be harnessed as a useful tool. Channeling it as a beam weapon would allow us to overheat and disable enemy ships. \n\nUnlocks a Colony Decision to construct a §YStarfire Cannon§! in orbit.

items.name: Fruit Gardens
items.desc: Vacuum gardens full of bio-engineered fruits, genetically enhanced to attract spaceborne fauna.

items.name: Psionic Aura Intensification
items.desc: Psionic emanations from the Shroud long to expand. With this new understanding, an empire's Psionic Auras can increase in intensity and spread throughout star systems, bringing benefits to allies and disadvantages to foes.

items.name: Psionic Suppression
items.desc: Devices that attenuate psionic energy are as difficult to construct as they are to understand. Such is the complexity of dealing with extradimensional forces.

items.name: Aura Resonation
items.desc: There is a way to project Psionic Auras beyond populated worlds. With the addition of an Psionic Projector, even a starbase can become a conduit for psionic emanations from the Shroud.

items.name: Materiality Engine
items.desc: The psionic energy of the Shroud adjoins every point in the physical galaxy. The Materiality Engine exploits this interface, making it possible to reach across dimensions and materialize valuable components and resources.

items.name: Psionic Bombers
items.desc: These small and nimble craft specialize in delivering concentrated payloads of psionic energy. The larger the target, the greater resonance its explosions achieve.

items.name: Psionic Lightning
items.desc: By establishing a temporary psionic connection between one ship and another, a direct charge of mental power can be discharged to devastating effect. Such raw energy is capable of confusing ship systems and influencing the minds of the crew within.

items.name: Psionic Disruptors
items.desc: These highly-advanced disruptors fire a powerful lance of psionic energy through enemy hulls, allowing for the targeted disabling of hostile weaponry.

items.name: Zro Launchers
items.desc: These highly concentrated pellets of zro can be dispersed through enemy shields unabated, shifting through multiple realities. Once contact is made with a physical object, the effects are exponential in devastation.

items.name: Interstellar Economics
items.desc: As we journeyed into the cosmos and ventured beyond our home system, we also entered a new era of economics. New markets are appearing a startling rate, and economic theorists are struggling to keep up.

items.name: Galactic Markets
items.desc: By engaging in free trade of goods and services we allow for a more specialized economy, where an individual can excel in a narrow field and trade for their needs.

items.name: Numistic Data Modeling
items.desc: Are the precognitive powers of Numa at work or is it a matter of skilled craftsmanship? Either way this galactic stock market prediction model will forecast fluctuations in the economy with divine accuracy.

items.name: Eco Simulation

items.name: Gene Crops
items.desc: Sophisticated genetic engineering of crops helps increase yield and further improves both taste and nutrient levels.

items.name: Nano-Vitality Crops
items.desc: Infusing crop strands with small amounts of nano-machines help create a type of produce that is ultra resilient, and the chemical composition of which can be tailored and altered during its entire lifetime.

items.name: Nutrient Replication
items.desc: The process of synthetically replicating crops requires a lot of collected waste to create a small amount of produce, but nevertheless provides a significant boost to agricultural output.

items.name: Hydroponics Farming
items.desc: Hydroponics Farming in a controlled environment allows for crops to be grown in climates where farming would normally be impossible.

items.name: Xenobiology

items.name: Neural Weaving
items.desc: Through recursive axonal scaffolding and synaptic reticulation, we have developed methods for reorganizing the electrochemical topology of conscious matter. Neurons do not merely transmit - they entwine, organize, and remember. Now, they do so according to our design.

items.name: Biostructural Synthesis
items.desc: Life, in all its staggering variety, is composed of repeating patterns and modular structures. By decoding and replicating these at every scale, we now wield a holistic blueprint of biology. There is little left in nature we do not understand, and less still we cannot recreate.

items.name: Xenology
items.desc: Studying the fauna of other worlds gives insight into alien behaviors, allowing us to identify and domesticate docile entities.

items.name: New Worlds Protocol
items.desc: Calculating required resources and gear required to establish a planetary colony allows us to herd brave pioneers into grand colony ships, confident that they will survive the long voyage across the stars to a new home.

swaps.name: New Worlds Initiative
swaps.desc: We turn our focus to calculating the resources and materials required to awaken new worlds, thereby readying our pioneer symbionts for their arduous voyages across the stars.

items.name: Atmospheric Filtering
items.desc: By adjusting atmospheric filtering on a per-site basis to better filter out undesirable elements, colonial living conditions may be improved.

items.name: Hostile Environment Adaptation
items.desc: Further study into the hazardous environments found on other planets help alleviate the difficulties that colonizers encounter in their day-to-day lives on foreign worlds.

items.name: Foreign Soil Enrichment
items.desc: Extensive study into different soil types and their ability to support crops will help improve the living conditions of our settlers on foreign worlds.

items.name: Eco-Integration Studies
items.desc: Additional study into different planetary climates will allow us to settle our population on worlds previously thought too hostile to support them.

items.name: Tomb World Adaptation
items.desc: Through comprehensive study of irradiated environments we will allow our settlers to colonize worlds that have been devastated by nuclear warfare.

items.name: Medical Care
items.desc: A micro-unit of prevention is worth a macro-unit of cure. Sometimes, however, both are needed.

items.name: Genetic Healthcare
items.desc: The colonization of alien worlds has opened up an entirely new field of biomedical research.

items.name: Cyto-Revitalization
items.desc: As our empire grows, so does our understanding of biology. Advanced medical treatments on a cellular level have allowed for significant advancements in biological population health.

items.name: Planetary Resurfacing
items.desc: With the advent of clean fusion, automation, and matter compression technologies, it was only a matter of time before mountain top removal became mountain range removal.

items.name: Deep Crust Engineering
items.desc: Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. Magma hotspots can now be exploited, suppressed, or even relocated.

items.name: Dangerous Wildlife Removal
items.desc: Tactical disruption of natural habitats combined with converging search-and-destroy patterns can effectively eliminate hostile wildlife in a very short span of time.

items.name: Selective Defoliants
items.desc: Thorough cataloging, gene sequencing, and computer modeling of exobotanical ecosystems, coupled with gene editing and dispersal mechanisms, will allow us to reshape alien plant communities to our liking.

items.name: Soil Remediation
items.desc: The process of soil deposition normally takes millions of years. With advanced fracking, chemical engineering, and hydraulic management technologies even the poorest substrate can be turned into fertile topsoil.

items.name: Xeno-Hydraulic Mastery
items.desc: Sapient races have been reclaiming swampland for thousands of years. A coordinated system of modular aqueducts, pump stations, chemical remediation crawlers and automated soil compactors can reclaim land at unprecedented speeds.

items.name: Climate Control Network
items.desc: Orbital systems of mirrors and shades can effect dramatic changes in planetary climates, when managed properly.

items.name: Ocean Ecology Management
items.desc: Given enough processing power, networked sensors and distributed stations, even the ocean currents can be managed to a fine level of control.

items.name: Subterranean Colonization
items.desc: Many planets exhibit extensive subsurface voids. Subterranean exploration, exploitation, and construction techniques can greatly increase the habitable area of some worlds.

items.name: Terrestrial Sculpting

items.name: Volcanic Terraforming
items.desc: Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. We can terraform a Volcanic World into a temperate planet.

items.desc: Careful reproductive planning should be incentivized, lest we waste valuable genetic legacies.

items.name: Capacity Boosters
items.desc: We leave nothing to chance, no matter the cost. Through exacting curation of DNA banks do we build the leaders of tomorrow.
